name: Kho Chay
steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes and cut into 3 cm cubes. Pat dry. Heat 25 ml oil and pan-fry tofu in batches for 7–8 minutes, turning until golden on several sides; remove.

Warm brown sugar with 20 ml coconut water in a small heavy pan over medium heat until amber, about 3–4 minutes. Carefully add remaining coconut water a little at a time; it will bubble, so keep hands clear.
In a clay pot or deep pan, heat remaining oil and cook shallots 3 minutes. Add garlic and shiitake and cook 4 minutes until the mushrooms begin to brown.
Pour in the caramel-coconut liquid and soy sauce. Add fried tofu, black pepper and salt. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes, then uncover for 5 minutes to reduce the sauce to a glossy coating.
Turn tofu carefully, scatter spring onions over it and serve hot with plain rice. Use clearly labelled vegetarian soy sauce for the caramel braise.
tips: Do not stir the tofu vigorously during braising; gently turn the cubes so they stay intact and absorb the caramel-soy sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
